alex: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel swap I'm seeing a late tail on 1F1B runs. microbatch latency spikes around steps ~48-64. root-level profiling attached? :thinking:
priya: I pulled a quick flame. all-reduce on ranks 2/3 is ~3-4x other ranks and KV cache miss rate jumps when we hit longer seqs. copying snippet below.

```
RANK 0 allreduce 1.2ms
RANK 1 allreduce 1.1ms
RANK 2 allreduce 3.9ms  <-- hotspot
RANK 3 allreduce 4.0ms  <-- hotspot
KV cache miss rate: 0.18 -> 0.45 at step 50
microbatch: 8 -> 16 (adaptive) around tail
kernel path: matmul.hybrid_f32_int8 selected by tuner (avg_seq=512)
```

jamie: that kernel selection detail matters — tuner picked a path tuned for avg seq length. tail still has seq ~1024 so kernel tiling/launch shapes are suboptimal. also microbatch boundary aligns weirdly with KV shards.
devon: repro suggestion: fixed seq 1024 + small microbatch to isolate. e.g. `rt-bench --pp --microbatch 4 --seq 1024 --profile`
infra-bot: booked repro node g4-48 at 2026-03-19T09:30Z for @alex and @priya :white_check_mark:
mara: hypothesis: KV fragmentation + eviction pattern when microbatch boundary sits inside attention window. leads to extra memcpy and noncontiguous tensors hitting allreduce slower paths. try forcing KV packing: `--kv-pack=full` and reduce kernel prefetch to 1.
alex: running both configs now (kv-pack=full / microbatch=8 & microbatch=4). if latency improves it's KV fragmentation; if not, we look at adding overlap buffers for allreduce.
priya: quick prefetch hack to try overlapping CPU/GPU prepare with reduce:
```
# pseudo
torch.cuda.synchronize()
stream_prefetch.record_event()
allreduce(tensor.contiguous(), async=True, stream=reduce_stream)
```
Might reduce stalls if contiguity is the main issue.
jamie: fallback if overlap hacks don't cut it: re-introduce a staggered 1F1B (2-step) for ranks with heavy seq variance and only for the tail. Or switch kernel tiling dynamically per microbatch.
devon: datapoint from repro: with `--kv-pack=full` + `--microbatch 8`, 99p latency dropped from ~560ms -> ~320ms. allreduce imbalance still shows but magnitude reduced.
alex: solid. I'll open a perf regression ticket and mark the kernel swap as a rollback candidate if further tests fail. creating PERF-2397 now. :memo:
mara: please add a unit test that synthesizes per-rank seq variance and asserts <=10% allreduce skew. also record full kernel selection log in the trace for every rollout.
infra-bot: repro node released. :rocket:
alex: next steps — (1) add KV packing toggle to runtime config, (2) add a lightweight allreduce-skew monitor metric, (3) follow up on kernel autotuner to prefer tail robustness over avg throughput for pp workloads. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
